records.statement: The 7,500 BTC SAFU transfer has no verified destination/transaction hash in the captured public sources; Binance's 90% replenishment and 100% XRP backing remain company claims until the full zero-knowledge PoR proof is published. Exchange-wallet totals are not tradable float.
records.impact: Misclassifying an internal reserve transfer as a market sale, or broad exchange custody as available selling supply, would contaminate capital-flow and price-prediction features.
unresolved: SAFU transfer destination and tx hash
Whether the 7,500 BTC was sold, converted, moved OTC or internally reallocated
Full Binance ZK PoR proof and same-time XRP customer liabilities
Exact crosswalk between CryptoQuant and XRP Insights Binance wallet sets
Customer versus cold/wrapped/operational XRP balance split
disconfirming_evidence: Arkham/Lookonchain show 7.5K BTC remaining/moved, while BitInfoCharts still displays 15K BTC with stale transaction timestamps.
XRP Insights shows Binance +17.6M XRP over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days, weakening a persistent drawdown narrative.
Binance states XRP is already 100% backed in the top-ten asset set.
